name: Taipei Open
stakes: This Taipei Open serves as a crucial mid-season opportunity for India's shuttlers to build momentum, consolidate rankings, and for some, to bounce back from recent disappointments on the international circuit.
summary:
India's contingent at the Taipei Open, a Super 300 event, presents a mix of top seeds and players looking to find their rhythm. Men's Doubles top seeds Satwiksairaj Rankireddy and Chirag Shetty will be aiming to assert their dominance, while Women's Singles star PV Sindhu, also a top seed, seeks to build on her recent Japan Open triumph, having experienced an early exit at the China Open. Her form remains a key storyline as she navigates the draw.

However, the campaign has already seen a significant setback with veteran HS Prannoy crashing out in the R16 after a straight-games defeat to Hong Kong's Jason Gunawan. This early exit will undoubtedly be a disappointment for the seasoned shuttler. Elsewhere, Lakshya Sen continues his pursuit of consistent performances, hoping for a deep run to boost his ranking and confidence. Young Women's Doubles pair Treesa Jolly and Gayatri Gopichand are back in action, and India's top Mixed Doubles duo, Dhruv Kapila and Tanisha Crasto, will also be looking to make their mark. Rising talent Malvika Bansod rounds out the singles challenge, eager to make a statement.
